laws.rule: Tassili n’Ajjer Cultural Park, named Djanet and Bordj El Haoues access points: Executive Decree 12-292 directs entry through surveillance/control posts. Tourist visits in designated protection zones must be organised through public bodies or licensed tourism agencies and accompanied by a park-appointed guide, approximately one guide per ten visitors. Agency activities in those zones need prior park-office authorisation. This is not a guide requirement throughout the whole wilaya or permission to cross an international border.

Tassili n’Ajjer Cultural Park protection zones: the decree prohibits collection of cultural/natural objects, unauthorised mineral or fossil removal, and damage to wild plants. Do not wet, take moulds of, scratch, write on or detach rock-art surfaces. Organised professional film/photo activity requires prior culture-ministry permission and an agreement with the park office; normal tourist admission does not provide this authorisation.

sources.title: JORADP: Executive Decree 12-292, Tassili n’Ajjer Cultural Park
sources.supports: Read directly: park boundaries and named control posts, organised protected-zone visits with appointed guide and prior agency authorisation, professional photography and rock-art/collection restrictions. Articles 28, 32 to 36.

local-law.note: Named cultural-park zones only. Original 2012/2014 instrument, not a verified current consolidation. Gate locations are mapped to present wilayas, not the older province labels. Current access, live zoning and later amendments not yet checked. No fee amounts reproduced.

festivals: Djanet Sebeiba: CNRPAH describes preparations (Timoulawine) from 2 to 9 Muharram and the ceremonies on 10 Muharram. This is a lunar cultural cycle, not a verified Gregorian date or a province-wide public holiday.

sources.title: CNRPAH: Sebeiba, Djanet
sources.authority: Centre national de recherches préhistoriques, anthropologiques et historiques, Algeria
sources.supports: Read directly: published 2024 description: preparations 2 to 9 Muharram, ceremonies 10 Muharram. Community documentation noted, not tourist permission.

culture-cycles.note: Exact forthcoming date, public attendance, photography and community permissions not yet checked. Documentation of community consent for heritage research is not tourist consent.
